ipos.name: Vinod Texworld Ltd (NSE Emerge, SME)

structural.sellers: None, the entire issue is fresh; promoter group incl. relatives 93.10% pre-issue, about 66.85% post-issue

notes: Draft prospectus, not the final one: the issue price, issue size, lot and dates were blank ([●]) on 29 Sep 2025. Enter the price once the prospectus is filed; the calculator then uses 45,56,800 new shares to work out the issue size and market cap.
Figures are restated under Indian GAAP (not Ind AS), shown in ₹ lakh in the document and converted here to ₹ crore.

Operating cash flow was negative in all three years (₹-11.85 cr FY25, ₹-6.68 cr FY24, ₹-5.86 cr FY23) while profit rose to ₹9.21 cr; receivables and inventories absorbed the cash. The company itself lists this as risk factor 3 (p.44).

The company has given a corporate guarantee of ₹76.27 cr for a loan of promoter-group company Vinod Cotfab Pvt Ltd, more than twice its own net worth of ₹31.98 cr (risk factor 5; contingent liabilities p.36). Amount payable to Vinod Cotfab was ₹39.61 cr at FY25, up from ₹7.15 cr a year earlier (p.39).
Top customer 16.3% and top ten customers 50.8% of FY25 revenue (p.43). Three group companies are in the same line of business (p.268).

Objects: plant expansion ₹6.39 cr, loan repayment ₹6.50 cr, working capital ₹18.50 cr, plus general corporate purposes capped at the lower of 15% of the issue or ₹10 cr under SME rules, and issue expenses (p.129). No monitoring agency because the issue is below ₹50 cr (p.141).

SME rules differ from the mainboard: minimum application above ₹2 lakh (two lots), at least 50% of the net issue to individual investors, a market-maker portion, and trading in lots after listing (p.87-88).

Peer table in the document: Jakharia Fabric P/E 13.3, Borana Weaves 10.9; an 'industry average' of 40.2 is cited from a magazine table (p.145). Promoters acquired no shares in the preceding year (p.39).
Three statutory/tax notices against the company totalling ₹0.49 cr (p.34). Effective tax rate FY25 25.6%.
